svg.aria-label: A 32-dimensional float32 vector is split into 8 sub-vectors; each becomes one byte
svg.title: A 32-dimensional float32 vector is split into 8 sub-vectors; each becomes one byte

text.tspan: One vector, 128 bytes in, 8 bytes out
8 codes × 1 byte = 8 bytes per vector, 16× smaller than 128 bytes
The codebook (256 centres per sub-space) is shared by all vectors and stored once.
